title: Water rate increases and $19.80 top tier
summary: At the April 21 meeting, a testifier opposed the proposed water rate increases. The testifier said the budget's top tier charges $19.80 per thousand gallons above 50,000 gallons. They also said neighbors got high bills when meters went unread for months and their use landed in the top tier.
